title: Hunts FH-029S: Open partner acceptance on the approved terms
detail: FH-029 built invites, acceptance and withdrawal, but no venue can accept yet: PARTNER_TERMS.approved in lib/hunts/partners.ts is false because docs/hunts/PARTNER-AGREEMENT.md is still a draft. Owed, after the owner approves the agreement (FH-028S, a human sign-off): set PARTNER_TERMS to the approved text's sha256 with approved true (lib/hunts/partners.test.ts fails until the two match the file), show the full approved terms on the accept screen (components/hunts/partner-screens.tsx shows a summary and the terms version only), link the partner list from the Hunt editor, and apply migration 20270346075000_hunt_partner_state.sql. Also owed by the author flow: nothing writes hunt_mission_placements.venue_space_id from a screen yet, so the publish guard has nothing to refuse until stops can be placed at a venue. Done when a named steward can read the approved terms and accept them on a preview deployment, and a forwarded link still shows a 404. Requires FH-028S. Hunts switches stay OFF.
